unlisted_practices: Embodied avatar with synchronized speech synthesis and animation for delivering therapy responses
Multi-layered real-time analysis of client statements (fact extraction, psychological flexibility process detection, emotion recognition) stored for supervising clinicians
Automated LLM-judge assessment of therapeutic response quality alongside expert psychotherapist ratings

screen.reason: The paper introduces and evaluates an embodied conversational agent system (Mind Companion) for process-based psychotherapy using automated metrics and expert psychotherapist ratings on real therapy session data, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard/practice intervention.
